page.layout: One page of text with a running head at top; main text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin; signature D 3 and catchword "tem-" at the foot.

main_text.l: XXXVII. Soli namque ii qui apti sunt,
materia vera sunt, quam docens erudiendam
{a}prosappello illos, qui qualitatibus a me sup-
quia verbo reperi possunt, repetitione nomi-
{d}rium a cæteris ad Deum recursum; desiderii
rum prima protinus actu adsit, necesse est;
utile cæteræ si adfint quoque actu ipso; alio-
qui sufficiat initiò, si incerus illarum amor,
infirmis namque bonæ voluntatis non præclu-
denda ad eruditionem via est; sed potius lex-
viganda, maxime initiò, ubi docentis ani-
necesse est; non modo quia omnem discipu-
lum principio esse debilem per se patet; sed
etiam quas possidet qualitatum veluti eclipsin
re, contingere poterit. Tunc igitur pruden-
tis est institutoris, vel omnino ad tempus ces-
sare, ne tempore paroxysmi præceptis in-
{a} Notes in the right margin are shown as marginal notes above.

marginalia.note: Quinam ii sint qui veritatis participandæ de sint capaces; infirmitatibus, prudentia, judicii, providique affectibus, maxime pro amore præ- caveant ini- tio; quæis tamen se accommodent, det erudi- tor necessit; & quomodo.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin are small italic and partly illegible; they were transcribed as best as possible. The section number "37." stands in the margin beside the first paragraph. Reference letters a–e are the marks in the text where the notes stand.
